name: Thronebound Causeway
introDiscord:
The festival street ends at the longest road in the kingdom.

A vast causeway stretches straight toward the royal throne complex.

Every place you've explored is visible behind you.
introTwitch:
The festival street ends at the longest road in the kingdom.

A vast causeway stretches straight toward the royal throne complex.

Every place you've explored is visible behind you.

thronebound-causeway-approach.prompt: Thronebound Causeway opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message: A ceremonial pilgrim chest contains Star Candies.

right.message: A Thronebound Colossus rises from the causeway.

forward.message:
A royal rest pavilion still contains restorative water.

Shizuki wrote:

'THRONE THIS WAY.

I am approximately 83% sure.

Glimmer says 100%.

Glimmer has become dangerously confident.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

thronebound-causeway-depths.prompt: Deeper within Thronebound Causeway, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: A Colossus guards the central bridge.

right.message: A royal processional coffer contains Star Candies.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's final kingdom map.

For once, there is exactly one arrow.

'THRONE →'

Underneath:

'SEE?

I CAN MAKE GOOD MAP.'

thronebound-causeway-threshold.prompt: Near Crownward Colonnade, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message:
A final causeway fountain restores strength.

Shizuki wrote:

'Last rest stop.

Next door better contain throne after all this.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A Thronebound Colossus blocks Crownward Colonnade.

forward.message: A ceremonial chest contains Star Candies beside the palace seal.

bossPromptDiscord:
The throne complex rises ahead.

One enormous guardian stands alone beneath Crownward Colonnade.

Behind it, the final palace doors remain closed.

Use /yes to approach the throne complex or /no to give
Shizuki more time to emotionally prepare for being correct about a map.
bossPromptTwitch:
The throne complex rises ahead.

One enormous guardian stands alone beneath Crownward Colonnade.

Behind it, the final palace doors remain closed.

Use !yes to approach the throne complex or !no to give
Shizuki more time to emotionally prepare for being correct about a map.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Crownward Colonnade. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The Colossus kneels.

The palace doors finally open.

Shizuki's writing appears on the frame:

'I WAS RIGHT.

THRONE.

RIGHT THERE.

EVERYONE WRITE THIS DOWN.'
